payload.claim_boundary: A future result may test whether cross-family disagreement predicts risk; this manifest alone establishes no validated trust policy.

diagnostics.arm_rank_disagreement: one minus arm-rank correlation when defined
diagnostics.effect_sign_disagreement_rate: one minus exact sign agreement over non-control contrasts; sign(0)=0
diagnostics.mean_absolute_effect_disagreement: mean absolute primary-vs-candidate normalized effect difference over non-control contrasts

future_evaluation.analysis: report fixed-direction risk-coverage descriptively; do not fit or tune a threshold unless a separate prospective protocol authorizes it
future_evaluation.minimum_label_gate: classification metrics not_estimable unless both classes have at least three independent experiments

payload.required_target_order: freeze both recommendations and all disagreement diagnostics before reveal
payload.task_eligibility: diagnostic is available only when the frozen primary and exact candidate model both complete the same outcome-blind arm grid
